limitations: The current 34.75 m dimension differs from the old 34.37. Neither the Lando-era auxiliary craft nor physical production-set sizes are treated as universal ship dimensions. The separately published 745 mph discussion is not converted into the inherited 1050 speed or projected into every owner period.

records.scope: First scoped review of an existing legacy vessel or station: original short description, all twelve inherited fields assessed, explicit individual/type/station boundaries and selected work/context links. Numeric ID, title, slug and origin retained.
limitations: The named Executor is distinct from a generic Imperial Star Destroyer or every Super Star Destroyer. The current page does not independently establish the inherited exact Executor-class star dreadnought model, Kuat/Fondor manufacturer combination or other numerical specifications.

The Battle of Endor collision concerns the later Death Star, not the first station represented by starships:9. No collision link to that first-station record is created. Officer succession is descriptive; no new person, cast or episode rows are added.

Only the stated details and selected connections are checked. Raw unestablished values and source IDs remain in the audit but are withheld from current published facts and collection previews. Other legacy relationships remain pending.
No new records, episode rows, credits, dates or editions. Original-US release research scope retained. A public reference is not an open text or media licence.
